changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Each result records the source kinds that it rests on, cited or consulted, so a history read checks its sources without loading its evidence. The kinds are written once: at insert, or by the schema owner when the upgrade records them for an earlier row. A recorded value never changes. One change set keeps the guard from running before its column exists.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The upgrade records the source kinds of the results that earlier releases wrote, with the extraction that new results use. It runs outside one transaction and commits as it writes, so it holds no lock on the whole table while older servers still run. A row that it has not reached yet reads its kinds from its evidence.

rollback.stop: The recorded source kinds cannot be told apart from the kinds that new results recorded at insert. Restore the database backup from before this upgrade.
